property_summary: For any caller address that can receive Ether, after depositing a positive amount and calling withdrawAll, the reference contract always successfully completes the withdrawal (call returns true) and does not revert; the mutant requires the call to fail (!callResult) so it will revert for such callable recipients, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Require that callResult is false instead of true, causing revert on successful sends and changing observable outcome.
